name: Conspiracy Uncle
description: Has done his own research. Will not elaborate.

storm.head: They're testing the weather machine again.
storm.sub: Don't ask me who 'they' are. Just stay inside and unplug the router.

storm.head: Thunder is just clouds arguing about who's real.
storm.sub: Stay inside. They can't see you through drywall.

storm.head: Lightning never strikes twice. Because it's aiming.
storm.sub: Don't be a target. Go inside.

storm.head: Storms are how the sky reboots.
storm.sub: It's installing updates. Unplug your stuff.

storm.head: Thunder is the sky's dial-up noise.
storm.sub: It's connecting to something. Unplug your router.

storm.head: I've got a bunker. Want the address?
storm.sub: No you don't. Just stay inside.

snow.head: Snow is just cold rain that's hiding something.
snow.sub: Taste it. That's not water. That's cover-up.

snow.head: Every snowflake is unique? Says who?
snow.sub: Have you checked them all? I've checked eleven. Two were the same.

snow.head: Snowplows know something.
snow.sub: Why are they always out before the snow? Think about it. Wear boots.

snow.head: Snow is just the sky's packing peanuts.
snow.sub: What's being shipped? Stay home and find out.

snow.head: Snow is just frozen cloud dandruff.
snow.sub: Disgusting. Wear a hat so it doesn't touch your head.

snow.head: Snowmen are watching. Always smiling.
snow.sub: Why? What do they know? {temp} out.

rain.head: Big Umbrella did this.
rain.sub: {pop}% chance of rain, right when umbrella stock goes up? Wake up.

rain.head: Rain is the sky's way of saying it knows.
rain.sub: It knows what you did. Bring a hood.

rain.head: Weathermen use umbrellas too. Suspicious.
rain.sub: They know. {pop}% chance. Cover your head.

rain.head: Puddles are portals. Don't step in them.
rain.sub: Worst case it's a portal. Best case, wet socks.

rain.head: Rain only falls down. Ever wonder why?
rain.sub: They don't want you asking. Bring an umbrella.

drizzle.head: That's not drizzle. That's surveillance mist.
drizzle.sub: Every droplet is a tiny camera. Smile, I guess.

drizzle.head: The sky is misting you like a plant.
drizzle.sub: Who's growing you? And for what?

drizzle.head: Drizzle is rain in disguise.
drizzle.sub: It thinks you won't notice. You noticed. Good.

drizzle.head: Drizzle is the sky testing you.
drizzle.sub: Whether you'll notice. You passed. Hood up.

drizzle.head: Mist is just shy rain.
drizzle.sub: Or is it? I've said too much.

drizzle.head: Ever see a drizzle documentary? Exactly.
drizzle.sub: Nobody talks about it. Hood up.

fog.head: Fog is just clouds that got too close.
fog.sub: Ask yourself why. Then turn your headlights on.

fog.head: Fog machines. Industrial scale.
fog.sub: Who's paying the electric bill on this one?

fog.head: The fog is where the birds recharge.
fog.sub: You didn't hear that from me. Drive slow.

fog.head: Fog only happens when they want it to.
fog.sub: Who's they? Don't worry about it. Drive slow.

fog.head: You can't photograph fog properly.
fog.sub: Try it. Blurry every time. Coincidence?

fog.head: Fog is clouds on a stakeout.

windy.head: Birds aren't flying today. Interesting.
windy.sub: Gusts to {gusts}. Because birds run on batteries and wind drains them. Look it up.

windy.head: Wind is just air that's late for something.
windy.sub: Late for WHAT? Gusts to {gusts}. Hold your hat.

windy.head: They're turning the big fans on again.
windy.sub: Wind at {wind}. Somebody's paying for that.

windy.head: Wind doesn't exist. It's trees fanning.
Birds are grounded today. Very convenient.
The wind took my hat in '09.
windy.sub: Never saw it again. Hold onto yours.

scorching.head: The sun is closer today. I measured.
scorching.sub: {temp}. Mainstream thermometers won't tell you the real number.

scorching.head: The sun is a big lamp and someone left it on.
Asphalt is soft today. Coincidence?
scorching.sub: Feels like {feels}. Don't walk barefoot, they're tracking footprints.

scorching.head: The thermometer is lying to you.
scorching.sub: It says {temp}. It's actually just hot. Stay inside.

scorching.head: Shadows are thinner today. Look.
scorching.sub: Feels like {feels}. They're up to something. Drink water.

scorching.head: The sun has never been to a doctor.

hot.head: {temp}? That's what they want you to think.
hot.sub: It's hotter. Drink water anyway. Water is one of the good ones.

hot.head: Sweat is your body leaking secrets.
Ice cream trucks are mobile listening posts.
hot.sub: Buy one anyway. It's {temp}. Treat yourself.

hot.head: Ever notice AC was invented in summer?
Lemonade stands are a front.
hot.sub: For what? Just buy a cup. It's {temp}.

freezing.head: Global warming, huh? Then explain THIS.
freezing.sub: Feels like {feels}. (That's called weather. Uncle won't listen. Wear gloves.)

freezing.head: Cold is just heat that gave up.
freezing.sub: {temp}. Don't give up like heat did. Wear a coat.

freezing.head: Icicles are nature's spikes.
freezing.sub: Defensive measures. Against what? Stay inside and think.

freezing.head: Your breath is visible. So are you.
freezing.sub: Feels like {feels}. Hat and scarf. Blend in.

freezing.head: Ice is just water that's hiding.
freezing.sub: From what? From you. Walk carefully.

freezing.head: Penguins are fine in this. Penguins know things.
freezing.sub: Feels like {feels}. Dress like a penguin.

cold.head: Cold front? More like cold FRONT ORGANIZATION.
cold.sub: High of {high}. Wear a jacket. They can't track you through wool.

cold.head: Ever notice it's cold every winter?
cold.sub: Every year. Like clockwork. Who's setting the clock?

cold.head: Hot cocoa is a distraction.
cold.sub: A delicious one. {temp}. Drink it, but stay alert.

cold.head: Your breath is a cloud. Who owns it?
cold.sub: Not you, apparently. {temp}. Scarf over your mouth.

cold.head: Thermostats are linked. All of them.
The cold drains your phone faster.
cold.sub: Coincidence? I don't think so. Keep it in a pocket.

nice.head: Nice weather. Suspicious.
nice.sub: Nothing is ever this nice for free. Go outside and keep your eyes open.

nice.head: Nothing's wrong. That's what's wrong.
nice.sub: {temp} and perfect. Enjoy it with one eye open.

nice.head: Birds are out today. Batteries must be charged.
nice.sub: Go outside. Wave at them. They report back.

nice.head: Perfect weather is how they get you outside.
nice.sub: Outside where they can see you. Go anyway, it's {temp}.

nice.head: The grass is greener. Literally. Why?
nice.sub: Go touch it and report back.

nice.head: Clear skies mean clear surveillance.
nice.sub: Wave at the satellites. Enjoy the {temp}.

meh.head: Clouds are just sky curtains.
meh.sub: What are they hiding up there? Nobody knows. {temp} down here.

meh.head: Gray days are when they do maintenance.
Clouds this boring are covering something.
meh.sub: Nothing to see up there. Which is exactly what they'd want.

meh.head: Gray is the color of secrets.
meh.sub: And this sky is full of them. Light jacket.

meh.head: Nobody remembers gray days. That's the point.

clearNight.head: Count the stars. Now count again.
clearNight.sub: Different number? Exactly. Go to bed, I'll keep watch.

clearNight.head: That's not a star. That's a satellite.
clearNight.sub: Most of them are. Wave anyway. Clear and {temp}.

clearNight.head: The moon follows you home. Every night.
clearNight.sub: Lock your door. Go to bed. It's {temp}.

clearNight.head: The moon has a dark side. Ask yourself why.
Shooting stars are just stars giving up.
clearNight.sub: Make a wish anyway. Clear and {temp}.

clearNight.head: Owls are awake. Owls see everything.
clearNight.sub: Go to bed before they notice you.
